raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
- With encoder SWA replay, a prefix hit's first chunk also runs up to 128 replay rows, and its extend is floored to whole pages. A per-rank chunk below `128 + page_size` (256-383 tokens with the 256-token page) floored that extend to zero, so `_select_prefill_admission` returned `OTHER` on every step and the waiting queue stalled behind the hit.
- `validate_deepseek_v41_encoder_replay_budget` now requires at least `128 + page_size` chunked prefill tokens per attention DP rank, up from 128.
- `handle_model_capability_adjustments` rejects `--enable-encoder-swa-bounded-replay` on models other than DeepSeek-V4.1. Only the DeepSeek-V4 architecture checked the flag before, so on any other model the generic scheduler and worker code still acted on it.
- `test_encoder_swa_replay.py` checks the floor; `test_prefill_adder.py` adds the boundary case, which still admits one page.

Servers with encoder replay and a per-rank chunk below that floor now fail at startup instead of stalling on the first prefix hit. Other models with the flag now fail at startup too. On gfx950, where exact chunk fill skips the page floor, chunks of 129-383 tokens also ran before; they now need 384 too.

files.patch:
@@ -238,15 +238,19 @@ def validate_deepseek_v41_encoder_replay_budget(server_args: ServerArgs) -> None
     cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
     if not cfg.enable_encoder_swa_bounded_replay:
         return
+    # A hit's first chunk also runs up to 128 replay rows and floors its extend to
+    # whole pages, so a smaller chunk leaves the hit no page and it never admits.
+    min_chunk = 128 + (cfg.page_size or 1)
     if (
         cfg.max_running_requests is None
         or cfg.max_running_requests <= 0
         or not cfg.chunked_prefill_size
-        or cfg.chunked_prefill_size < 128
+        or cfg.chunked_prefill_size < min_chunk
     ):
         raise ValueError(
             "encoder SWA replay requires --max-running-requests > 0 and at least "
-            "128 chunked prefill tokens per attention DP rank"
+            f"{min_chunk} chunked prefill tokens per attention DP rank (128 replay "
+            "tokens plus one page)"
         )

@@ -389,6 +389,7 @@ def test_encoder_replay_rows_share_the_chunk(self):
             (0, 1024, 1024),
             (64, 1024, 960),
             (4096, 1024, 896),
+            (4096, 192, 64),  # the startup floor: replay rows plus one page
             (4096, 128, None),
         ):
             with self.subTest(prefix_len=prefix_len, rem_chunk=rem_chunk):

@@ -614,6 +614,23 @@ def __getattr__(self, name):
         raise _PastEncoderReplayChecks(name)
 
 
+class TestEncoderReplayChunkFloor(CustomTestCase):
+    def _validate(self, chunked_prefill_size):
+        view = _View(
+            enable_encoder_swa_bounded_replay=True,
+            max_running_requests=8,
+            chunked_prefill_size=chunked_prefill_size,
+            page_size=256,
+        )
+        with patch.object(deepseek_v4_hook, "resolving_view", return_value=view):
+            deepseek_v4_hook.validate_deepseek_v41_encoder_replay_budget(object())
+
+    def test_chunk_holds_the_replay_rows_and_a_page(self):
+        self._validate(384)
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "at least 384 chunked prefill"):
+            self._validate(383)
+
+
 class TestEncoderReplayDpStartupCheck(CustomTestCase):
